t: What Ocean Circulation Observation Database Is All About
title: What Ocean Circulation Observation Database Is All About
description: Ocean circulation moves heat around the planet: the Gulf Stream carries ~30 Sverdrups (million m³/s) warming Europe; the thermohaline conveyor sinks cold salty water in the North Atlantic and upwells it in the Pacific centuries later. ARGO's 4,000 drifting floats profile temperature and salinity globally. AMOC slowdown warnings (2020s) show circulation is climate's vulnerable flywheel. This database is the complete circulation observation: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
